correctness.rationale: Stars-and-bars gives exact one- and two-singleton indicator probabilities in the uniform weak-composition law. The rational covariance reduces to a monic cubic with roots separated by 0 and q; \(\(F_q(2)\)\) fixes the discrete boundary. Root bracketing at ±sqrt(q)-3/4 yields \(O(q^{-1/2})\) displacement, and expansion yields \(\((1-s^2)/32\)\). Standalone standard-library exact checks enumerated 373,343 weak compositions over 116 parameter settings. Finite experiments are corroboration, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The Pólya unit-reinforcement urn is a canonical distribution of overdispersed occupancy counts. The non-monotone sign of exactly-once indicators, with two crossings at \(q\pm\sqrt q\) and an explicit \(O(q^{-2})\) positive island invisible to fixed-density first-order asymptotics, identifies a structural finite-size dependence transition and contrasts the iid occupancy model. A complete natural-parameter classification has value independent of further downstream theorems.
